ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Art
ns2:course.description: Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 6 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 12 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing or consent of instructor.
